## Change

Describe the concrete change and why it is needed.

## Validation

List checks actually run, their results, and any unverified behavior.
For scaffold changes: `python scripts/verify_setup.py`.
For research changes: include the relevant scientific checks and run IDs.

## Research impact

Does this change the loss, teacher update, splits, attack, checkpoint
selection, or comparison? If so, link the protocol/config and decision-log
updates. Identify affected runs and whether they remain comparable.
